conflicts.permit: We may also disclose your data to comply with the law or to protect the rights, property or safety of us, our players or others.
conflicts.prohibit: We will only disclose information with your consent where we are legally able.
conflicts.situation: Disclosing user data to comply with legal obligations or protect property when the user has not provided consent.
